items.title: How Big Is Micron Technology (MU) $100 Billion Syracuse Factory Bet?
items.summary: Micron Technology (NasdaqGS: MU) plans a historic US$100b semiconductor manufacturing complex in the Syracuse, New York area. The planned complex is expected to create about 9,000 Micron jobs and roughly 40,000 additional roles across suppliers and services. Local officials describe the project as a potential anchor for reindustrialization in a region often labeled part of the former Rust Belt.
